assertions.assertion: The claim was denied under denial code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The palpitations and lightheadedness are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia.
Supraventricular tachycardia is coded as I47.1.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary artery is coded as I25.10.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting.
The statement about capturing arrhythmic events appears in the ordering note.
The payer letter states the decision does not preclude a corrected claim.
The payer letter states the decision does not preclude an appeal.
The denial involves an authorization/precertification requirement.
